In transaction 0x6ed07db1a9fe5c0794d44cd36081d6a6df103fab868cdd75d581e3bd23bc9742 (2025-11-03) the pool held 67,000 wei of WETH and 67,000 wei of osETH (scaling factor 1058132408689971699, fee 0.01%), and 30 rounds of three given-out swaps (osETH out down to 18 wei, then 17 wei of osETH out, then WETH out paid with osETH) took its invariant from 137,893 to 2,445. A request for 17 wei of osETH is worth 17.988 of the pool's 18-decimal units, but the pool math is asked to price 17 units: the first such swap was charged 625,492 wei of WETH, while 18 units cost 1,041,412.
